applicabilityBasis.summary: krUSDC represents a yield-accruing USDC lending-vault position. The official Morpho page maps the exact Arc contract to Keyrock Prime USDC and Vault V2. The framework uses ERC-4626 share accounting with variable assets per share, interest and loss recognition, and liquidity-dependent exits. The reviewed instrument is a strategy receipt, not a fixed-value payment or settlement instrument or a promise by an issuer to redeem for fixed monetary value under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: The assessment applies to the Arc vault share at 0x5befab92a5a3d60f578cb51eeb4e4fd50a1e3123, separately from underlying USDC. The official product page identifies Keyrock as curator. A curator brand does not establish a separate legal payment-stablecoin issuance obligor, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. Vault shares accrue lending returns and can lose value; exits depend on strategy liquidity and may retain underlying lending-position exposure. Underlying USDC authorizations, reserves, and attestations are not vault-share authorizations, reserves, or attestations. No finding on securities status or other financial-services requirements is made.
